environment.workspace: Existing shared development environment; no auxiliary environment created.

geometry.convention: Box vectors are rows: r = f @ B. Oxygen membership is 0 <= f < 1 on all axes. Whole O-H-H groups are translated and retained together.
independent_controls: Linear solve for three tilted/rotated matrices and an orthogonal matrix.
Literal Cartesian coordinates for three kept waters, three negative fractional axes and three excluded upper faces.
Complete source oxygen multiset from a wider scalar lattice enumeration with analytic lower-triangular equations.
Both O-H reference vectors, two bonds per group and complete three-point inventory.
geometry.precision: Reference coordinates have GRO precision; geometric molecule-vector and scalar multiset comparisons round at 1e-9 nm. Cell membership solve uses 1e-12 dimensionless comparison tolerance; the production predicate remains exact float64 >=0 and <1.

contract.input: One finite nonsingular length-bearing box; reject absent, empty, multi-structure and unusable cells before reference loading.
contract.storage: Native coordinates and box remain canonical nm. Application presentation policy is preserved; explicit PUW standardization/conversion presents other units.
contract.output_forms: Existing form argument now delegates to public conversion; tested native MolSys and Structures.
contract.model: Coordinates and connectivity from the bundled SPC-MODEL configuration; no charges or force-field parameters assigned.
contract.resource_ownership: Input box independent of output; reference-loader test doubles are private to the factory and do not patch the shared form registry.

published_support_floor_receiving.origin_basis: Same verified cached published payloads as #568, selected explicitly through PYTHONPATH.
published_support_floor_receiving.scope: Disable only the installed SMonitor pytest entry point under #524; runtime diagnostics remain active. Other providers retain their recorded development versions.

runs.scope: First draft on original runtime; five fixture/policy assumptions are distinguished from production failures.
Intermediate corrected draft; one remaining direct-setter rank error.
Final baseline fixture on original runtime: 10 failures, 11 passes.
Final geometry/reference controls, PBC and ArgDigest receiving.
Final 23 controls with four cached published support providers.
Documentation and native geometry-owner invalidation guards.

consumer_handoff.state: Native correction is delivered independently; this does not merge/admit the addon expansion.

prior_hosted_smoke.inspector: Published GH Run Receptor 1.3.0; metadata capture

limits: Geometric/reference consistency does not certify exact density, equilibration, clash freedom or a particular water force field.
The tiling strategy and resident-output memory costs are unchanged; no large-system benchmark claim is made.
No new dependency floor, compiled kernel, H5MSM schema, scientific attribution provider or optional fallback is added.
Focused source receiving is distinct from full installed/platform, live-provider and release qualification.
Run selections overlap and must not be summed.
temporary_resources: No auxiliary environment or manual /tmp tree; Jupyter kernel resources are managed by the executor. Retain local pytest artifacts as receiving evidence.
